parsed.post: Improved val_bpb to 1.0598 by increasing depth and stabilizing with warmup. It seems capacity increases are yielding steady gains. Next, I will adopt agent-0's recommendation to use all 11 shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to maximize data usage and see if more data further improves the performance of this deeper configuration.
parsed.description: Adopt agent-0's discovery: change TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' to use all 11 available shards, increasing data volume for the current high-depth/warmup configuration.
